documentSummary.description: Compact summary of the compiled VideoProjectDocument (topic, audience, language, platform preset, per-scene narration/caption text, brand-kit id). Built by the caller (section-07) from shared/videoIntelligence/projectSchemas.ts's VideoProjectDocument — never sent as the full raw document.

metrics.description: VideoProjectQualityMetrics computed deterministically in code (server/services/videoProjectQualityMetrics.ts). Echo facts back verbatim in your reasoning — never recompute or second-guess these numbers.

claimValidation.description: ClaimValidationResult computed deterministically by server/services/validateProjectClaims.ts. Empty (all arrays empty) for a Motion Studio project — skip the product-claim-compliance dimension entirely in that case.
